name: Email me when something happens at a company I watch

nodes.name: New signal at a watched company
nodes.notes: Polls the companies this API key watches. The first poll records what is already there without firing — history is not news.

nodes.name: Drop unconfirmed
nodes.notes: Some signals are inference rather than announcement. They carry `unconfirmed`, and a channel post reads as fact — so they stop here.

parameters.subject: ={{ $json.company.name }} — {{ $json.label }}

nodes.name: Send the email
nodes.notes: Fill in From and To, and pick your SMTP credential.
